2607.05364.title: REDDIT: Correcting Model-Generated Timestamp Drift in ASR without Forgetting via Replay-Based Distribution Editing
2607.05364.paper_summary: Modern autoregressive ASR systems can emit timestamps as decoded tokens, enabling timestamped transcription without frame-level aligners or inference-time post-processing. We show that these generated timestamps can drift across long non-speech spans: the transcript may remain plausible, but the decoded time axis drifts away from the audio. We study this non-speech-induced timestamp drift with self-built gap and long-gap benchmarks across 15 evaluated timestamp-producing ASR and audio-language systems. Naive timestamp-corrected fine-tuning improves alignment but can severely degrade non-target ASR behavior, exposing a forgetting problem. We propose REDDIT(REplay-based Distribution eDITing), a lightweight two-stage post-training framework that corrects timestamps while avoiding this catastrophic forgetting: it first edits timestamp targets under the model's own replayed decoder context while matching the frozen base distribution on non-timestamp tokens, then applies a short edited-prefix refinement stage. In this framework, we construct correction supervision without human transcripts or human timestamp annotations by combining VAD-trimmed speech spans with inserted non-speech gaps and known concatenation offsets. On Whisper-tiny, 34.9 hours of targeted correction audio used and only 1.6% of model parameters updated, raising long-gap mIoU from 38.7% to 95.0% and reducing mixed-gap out-of-domain AAS from 2752 ms to 223 ms while preserving CV-en MER at 41.3% (versus 524.2% for ordinary SFT decoder tuning).
2607.05364.paper_summary_zh: 現代自回歸自動語音識別（ASR）系統可以將時間戳作為解碼的標記輸出，實現無需逐幀對齊器或推理時後處理的時間戳轉錄。<lb/>我們顯示這些生成的時間戳在長時間的非語音區間中可能會漂移：轉錄可能仍然合理，但解碼的時間軸卻與音頻脫節。<lb/>我們通過自建的間隙和長間隙基準，研究這種非語音引起的時間戳漂移，涵蓋了15個評估的生成時間戳的ASR和音頻語言系統。<lb/>天真的時間戳修正微調雖然改善了對齊，但可能會嚴重降低非目標ASR行為，暴露出遺忘問題。<lb/>我們提出了REDDIT（基於重播的分佈編輯），這是一個輕量級的兩階段後訓練框架，能在避免這種災難性遺忘的同時修正時間戳：它首先在模型自身重播的解碼器上下文中編輯時間戳目標，同時在非時間戳標記上匹配凍結的基礎分佈，然後應用短的編輯前綴細化階段。<lb/>在這個框架中，我們通過將VAD修剪的語音區間與插入的非語音間隙和已知的連接偏移量結合，構建無需人類轉錄或人類時間戳註釋的修正監督。<lb/>在Whisper-tiny上，使用了34.9小時的目標修正音頻，僅更新了1.6%的模型參數，將長間隙的mIoU從38.7%提高到95.0%，並將混合間隙的域外AAS從2752毫秒減少到223毫秒，同時保持CV-en MER在41.3%（相比於普通的SFT解碼器調整的524.2%）。
